name: pramoxine + zinc oxide
purpose: Purpose Skin Protectant Purpose External Analgesic
uses: Use Dries the oozing and weeping, and temporarily relieves pain and itching of poison ivy, poison oak, poison sumac or other minor skin irritations.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last for more than 7 days, or clear up and occur again within a few days.
